title: Internal Hom adjunction for finite etale direct image
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $f:T\to S$ a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Work on small etale sites with constant $A$-module sheaves and their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $f_*=Rf_*$ for exact finite direct image and $f^!:D^+(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)\to D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ for its right adjoint, equivalently the bounded-below compact-support exceptional adjoint [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. For $M\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $N\in D^+(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ there is a natural isomorphism in the ordinary unbounded category $D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$
$$f_*R\mathcal Hom_A(M,f^!N)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_A(f_*M,N)$$
[def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The map is induced by evaluation followed by the counit $f_*f^!N\to N$. A finite morphism of Noetherian schemes is proper, hence compactifiable with $Rf_!=f_*$; the ambient right adjoint $f^\times$ of [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] carries $D^+(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ into $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and restricts there to $f^!$. Under this identification the displayed isomorphism is the instance for $f$ of the canonical internal adjunction of [prop-asd-internal-adjunction], with the evaluation--counit normalization of [lem-asd-internal-adjunction-evaluation]; the assertions below are its compatibilities. It is compatible with shifts, restrictions to etale objects of $S$, and the right-adjoint composition identifications. In particular, with $M=A_T$ it identifies $R\mathcal Hom_A(f_*A_T,N)$ with $f_*f^!N$. For a finite $g:V\to T$, the internal-Hom map induced by the counit $g_*g^!M\to M$ corresponds under these isomorphisms to the map induced by applying $g^!$ to a morphism $M\to f^!N$.

source.place: Expose XVII, proof of Proposition 5.4.1, pp. 291 and 293: the two internal-Hom adjunction identifications for finite maps; ordinary etale coefficients, with no constructibility assumption
